title: Exam 1
subtitle: Neurological Function & Maintaining Homeostasis

practiceExams.note: The blueprint lists 32 topic questions plus 6 dosage calculation out of 50 total. CVA/aneurysm (11) is split here into Stroke (8) and Aneurysm (3) to match the study guide. The remaining questions are spread across the Exam 1 topics in the same proportions as the blueprint.

outcomes: Perform focused neurological and systemic assessments
Recognize common disease processes, pathophysiology, differentiation of disease processes, and evidence-based nursing care
Prioritize client care: ABCs, perfusion, risk for deterioration, medications
Recognize and respond to deteriorating patient condition; evaluate teaching and identify need for further teaching
Promote patient safety and reduce risk; recognize cues and filter key findings from noise
Provide patient-centered communication and education; analyze cues and link symptoms to diagnoses
Generate solutions: select appropriate nursing interventions and plan safe, evidence-based care
Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams: preparation for procedures, provider communication, diagnostic coordination

objectives.title: Maintaining Homeostasis
items: Understand how disease processes lead to imbalanced electrolytes and shock
Identify nursing assessments and interventions that maintain homeostasis through compensation of the major organ systems
Recognize and manage the resulting complications

objectives.title: Alteration in Neurological Function
items: Explain the pathophysiology of neurological function
Explore epidemiological and etiological risk factors for alterations in neurological function
Describe the impact of alterations in neurological function on a client's overall health
Differentiate the clinical presentation of clients with alterations in neurological function
Explore the role of the nurse when caring for these clients
Apply the nursing process through the clinical judgment functions
